title: Market Survey for the followings part numbers- S007250, S007251, S007252, and S007260 � associated with the Black Hornet (BH4) Unmanned Aircraft.
description: Sources sought to provide the government with the unmanned Aircraft ( 1550-25-163-7663), Unmanned Aircraft Main Module (1550-25-163-7895); Grip Assembly, Controller AC ( 1680-25-163-7661), and Case, Electronic Communication (Hangar) ( 5895-25-163-7662, for the U.S. Military. The AN/ZSH-3(V)1 Black Hornet 4 (BH4) is a soldier Borne Sensor (SBS) designed specifically for dismounted Operators. It provides lower echelon units with an organic and immediate capability for enhancing situational awareness with minimal increase in equipment volume and weight. Requirements Description: The United States Army is looking for sources with the ability to provide the S007250 Unmanned Aircraft Vehicle (1550-25-163-7663), S007251 Unmanned Aircraft Main Module (1550-25-163-7895), S007260 Grip Assembly Controller AC (1680-25-163-7661), and the S007252 Case, Electronic Communication (Hangar) (5895-25-163-7262) for the AN/ZSH-3(V)1 BH4. The Government requires an estimated quantity of 21 S007250, 12 S007251, 12 S007260, and 12 S007252 over a 3-year period. This is not a solicitation. This is only an estimate and will not bind the contractor or the Government in any way or at any time into a contract with any of the specified terms below. Suppliers capable of supplying these items, in accordance with the government data package and in the quantities specified above, should contact the government before October 16, 2026. Submissions can be sent to michelet.audige.civ@army.mil. Responses must include a list of items the supplier is able to produce or source as well as documentation that the supplier can provide the army with a physically and functionally component from the list above. Examples of such documentation can be test results, copy of purchase orders if the supplier was a vendor to the listed source, or a statement from listed source demonstrating that the supplier can provide the Army a solution. For more information contact Michelet Audige at michelet.audige.civ@army.mil. Items and/or Services to Be Procured: NSN: 1550-25-163-7663 NOMENCLATURE: Unmanned Aircraft Main Module PART NUMBER: S007251 CAGE: N5387 NSN: 1550-25-163-7895 Nomenclature: Unmanned Aircraft Main Module Part Number: S007251 Cage:N5387 NSN: 1680-25-163-7661 NOMENCLATURE: Grip Assembly, Controller AC PART NUMBER: S007260 CAGE:N5387 NSN: 5895-25-163-7662 NOMENCLATURE: Case Electronic Communication (HANGAR) PART NUMBER: S007252 CAGE:N5387 Requested Response Information: We request that sources who can manufacture the listed parts or services submit information to show their capability. At a minimum the support information you submit should include, but is not limited to, the following types of documentation: Questionnaire, information on previous Government and commercial contracts, and evidence that the item can be provided. In your response, please include your company name, CAGE code, and a technical point of contact with email address and telephone number. Notice, Response Due Date, and Points of Contact: This is NOT a Request for Quote or Proposal. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this SSA or reimburse any costs associated with the preparation of responses to this SSA. This Sources sought announcement (SSA) is for planning and market research purposes only and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government. The information gathered from this announcement will be used to determine if responsible sources exist, and to assist in determining if this effort can be competitive and/or set aside for Small Business. Furthermore, the Government will use the information, in part, to determine the best acquisition strategy for a potential procurement action and/or to assist in making acquisition strategy decisions in the future. title: Dworshak Powerhouse Roof Replacement
description: Title: Dworshak Powerhouse Roof Replacement: The work is located at the Dworshak Powerhouse, Ahsahka, Idaho. The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bid (IFB) and result in a single firm-fixed price construction contract. This procurement is unrestricted. Competition is open to both large and small business concerns. A small business subcontracting plan is required for large businesses. 100% performance and payment bonds will be required for this project. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS code for this project is 238160 Roofing Contractors, and the associated small business size standard is $19 million in average annual receipts. Solicitation number W912EF27BA001 will be posted to the SAM.gov Contract Opportunities website on or about mid to late October 2026. The bid due date will be contained in the solicitation and any solicitation amendments that may be issued. The solicitation will be made available for download on the SAM.gov Contract Opportunities website. Offerors are responsible for checking the referenced page for any updates to the Notice. The Government is not responsible for any loss of Internet connectivity or for an offeror's inability to access the documents posted at the referenced website. Bids will be due approximately 30 days after the solicitation is posted. The exact proposal due date will be indicated in the solicitation. System for Award Management (SAM): Offerors must register in the SAM at https://sam.gov/content/home prior to receiving an award. NOTE: The response date that is required to post this notice is not in any way a due date for any submission. This is a pre-solicitation notice only. Scope: The scope of the work is to provide a durable waterproofing system for the Dworshak powerhouse and ancillary roofs. This will be achieved by removing the existing roofing system in its entirety down to the structural roof decks, followed by the installation of a new fully adhered roofing assembly to include gypsum roof sheathing, a vapor retarder, polyisocyanurate foam roof insulation, cover board, and 90-mil EPDM membrane. A 2-year installer warranty and a 30-year manufacturer warranty are required. Fall protection guardrails constructed from fiber-reinforced plastic (FRP) will be installed to the parapet walls of the powerhouse and elevator penthouse roofs to ensure a safe work environment for maintenance personnel conducting preventative maintenance activities on the roofs. Fabricated metal stairs will be installed to replace existing ladder access to two roof areas. The mechanical air conditioning unit for the elevator machine room will be replaced with a new split heat pump system with indoor air handler and outdoor condenser unit. Roof parapet heights above the parking lot/roadway range from 36 feet high to 75 feet high. Cranes and/or telescopic boom lifts will be necessary to deliver material on to the roof surfaces. High voltage equipment and overhead transmission lines will limit placement and reach of equipment. Demolished materials may be removed using cranes, telescopic boom lifts, or debris chutes. THE GOVERNMENT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CANCEL THE SOLICITATION EITHER BEFORE OR AFTER THE CLOSING DATE. NO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO THIS PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE OR ANY FOLLOW-UP INFORMATION REQUEST. All on-site work shall be performed in accordance with the Corps of Engineers Safety and Health Requirements Manual (EM 385-1-1). Establish and manage an effective on-site Safety and Health program in accordance with EM 385-1-1 that will require the development and submission of a comprehensive project specific Accident Prevention Plan for Government acceptance. In addition, develop and submit for Government acceptance Activity Hazard Analyses for each phase of work and a project specific Fall Protection Plan that comply with EM 385-1-1. A Site Safety and Health Officer (SSHO) employed by the prime contractor is required for each shift of the contractor's on-site operations. The SSHO shall possess a minimum of 5-years� experience in construction safety on similar projects, shall have completed the 30-Hour OSHA Construction Safety training within the last 5 years, and shall have completed at least 24 hours of safety training from accredited safety training sources each year for the past 5 years. Establish and manage an effective Contractor Quality Control (CQC) System that will require the development and submission of a comprehensive project specific CQC Plan for Government acceptance. A CQC System Manager employed by the prime contractor is required to be on-site for each shift of the Contractor's operations. The CQC System Manager must possess a minimum of 5 years relevant experience in a supervisory or management position such as Quality Control Manager, Quality Assurance Manager, or Construction Manager directly involved in the management of construction quality at the project site. In addition, the CQC System Manager shall have completed the course entitled �Construction Quality Management for Contractors� within the last 5 years. Use the Government-furnished Resident Management System (RMS) � Contractor Mode to record, maintain, and submit various information throughout the contract period. RMS is a Windows-based program capable of operating on a stand-alone personal computer or on a network. The Government will make the quality control system (QCS) software available to the Contractor at time of notice to proceed. The project involves the development and management of Contractor furnished submittals for items such as pre-construction plans, product data, test reports, and contract close-out documentation as required by the technical specifications of the contract. Miscellaneous work within the project includes the delivery of As-Built Drawings, O&M Manuals, Contractor- Prepared Shop Drawings, and spare parts to the customer. Solicitation Number W912EF27BA001 will be posted to the SAM.gov approximately on around mid to late October 2026. The solicitation is a Request for Proposal Important Note: The SAM.gov Contract Opportunities Response Date listed elsewhere in this synopsis is for SAM.gov archive purposes only. It does not necessarily reflect the actual bid opening date. There is no response date included in this notice. The bid due date and time will be contained in the solicitation and any solicitation amendments that are issued. Anticipated Award date is January 2027. A site visit will be offered approximately 2 weeks after the solicitation is made available to offerors. See solicitation for details about the site visit. ACCESS FOR FOREIGN NATIONALS: Security clearance for foreign nationals to attend a site visit requires approximately 4 weeks; therefore, clearance should be requested immediately. To request clearance, please submit the names of all foreign nationals proposed for site visit attendance, along with documentation to verify that he/she was legally admitted into the United States and has authority to work and/or go to school in the US. Such documentation may include a US passport, Certificate of US citizenship (INS Form N-560 or N-561), Certificate of Naturalization (INS Form N-550 or N-570), foreign passport with 1-551 stamp or attached INS Form 1-94 indicating employment authorization, Alien Registration Receipt Card with photograph (INS Form 1-151 or 1-551), Temporary Resident Card (INS Form 1-688}, Employment Authorization Card (INS Form l-688A}, Reentry Permit (INS Form 1-327}, Refugee Travel Document (INS Form 1-571}, Employment Authorization Document issued by the INS which contains a photograph (INS Form I-688B}. description: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE 658-19-103 Renovate Surgical Suite Phase II Salem VA Medical Center (Salem, Virginia) The Department of Veterans Affairs, Salem VA Medical Center in Salem, Virginia, has a requirement for a contractor to provide construction services to complete Project 658-19-103 Renovate Surgical Suite Phase II in accordance with the solicitation and any resulting contract. DESCRIPTION: Project 658-19-103 Renovate Surgical Suite Phase II: This construction services project includes general construction, structural, architectural, fire suppression, plumbing, mechanical, electrical, and fire alarm systems trades to perform work in Building 143 at the Salem VA Medical Center. The purpose of the project is to expand and renovate an existing surgical suite to comply with the current VA design guidelines and provide innovative functional spaces. This requirement corrects several outstanding deficiencies discovered during the facilities condition assessment (FCA) as a result of obsolete equipment and infrastructure for surgical services per the VA Design Manual and other dictating medical codes. The project will be broken down into four phases with each phase being completed and activated prior to the next phase beginning. The first phase will consist of creating three new operating rooms in a currently vacant area of the hospital, resulting in no impact to operating room functions. The second phase will include complete renovation of the existing operating rooms, and patients will be re-routed to the new operating rooms constructed during the first phase. Phase three will include the nursing station pre-op area. This is not expected to impact patient care as alternative areas nearby will be used for post-op. The final phase includes what is currently the post-op recovery and surgical area. The place of performance is the Salem VA Medical Center at 1970 Roanoke Blvd. Salem VA 24153. The period of performance for this project is 840 calendar days from the issuance of Notice to Proceed (NTP). MAGNITUDE OF CONSTRUCTION: Between $20,000,000 and $50,000,000. title: Z--Laboratory Facility Operation & Maintenance
description: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Region 7, Acquisition Management Branch, is seeking the services of an experienced firm to provide Facility Operations and Maintenance services for the U.S. EPA Region 10 Manchester Laboratory, 7411 Beach Dr. East, Port Orchard, WA, which provides chemical analysis; microbiological analyses; whole effluent toxicity; method development and other applied science activities; design consultation for environmental projects; and other related activities. The R10 Manchester Laboratory complex is comprised of multiple buildings in which all buildings are single story occupancy with some mechanical spaces on a second floor or mezzanine. Buildings are clustered near one another on a 17.5-acre site, including approximately 3 acres of landscaped areas, and 3 acres of paved areas and roadway. This facility houses approximately 85 federal, state and contract employees. The work to be performed under this contract consists of continuous service of its mechanical systems with little or no breakdowns; effective maintenance to ensure facility preservation; and efficient operation of systems and equipment. Additional services may be ordered at the discretion of the Government for work relating to the operations, maintenance and repair or upgrade of the covered facilities, but not covered in the basic monthly services of the contract. The Period of Performance (POP) for this procurement will be one (1) Base Period and four (4) Option Periods. Estimated dollar value for this procurement is between $5M - $8M. This procurement will be a total Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business set-aside. The RFP is anticipated to be issued on or about 10/16/2026 and will be posted on the System for Award Management (SAM) website (www.sam.gov) and the FedConnect website (www.fedconnect.net).

title: Denmark – Construction work – Løvbakkernes Vandværk
description: Ordregiver udbyder en totalentreprisekontrakt vedrørende projektering, opførelse og idriftsættelse af Løvbak-kernes Vandværk nord for Herning. Vandværk placeres på matrikel nr. 1r, Gullestrup, Herning Jorder. Det nye vandværk skal have en produktionskapacitet på 3 millioner m³/år, med mulighed for udvidelse til 4,5 millioner m³/år efter 2040. Hovedformålet med det nye vandværk er at sikre fremtidens produktion af drikkevand og højne Herning Vands forsyningssikkerhed. Desuden ønskes muligheden for at kunne udvide vandværket på sigt og sikre fleksibilitet i forhold til den fremtidige efterspørgsel på rent vand. Det nye vandværk ved Løvbakkerne omfatter blandt andet byggemodning, vandværksbygning, el- og maskinan-læg, håndtering af skyllevand og overfladevand, vejanlæg og udenomsarealer på vandværksgrundens matrikel. Visionen hos ordregiver er, at vandværket opføres på en måde, hvor det integreres harmonisk og naturligt i land-skabet. Samtidig ønskes placeringen tæt på forsyningens boringer og eksisterende læringsmiljøer udnyttet, så vandværkets udearealer bliver centrum for et nyt læringsrum med fokus på bæredygtig vandforvaltning, grund-vandsbeskyttelse og formidling om vand. Det nye vandværk forventes færdigt medio 2029.

title: Strømavtale for innkjøp og videreformidling av kraft
description: 1 Oppdraget 1.1 Om oppdragsgiveren Ål Kraftverk KF, heretter kalt oppdragsgiveren, innbyr til konkurranse om innkjøp av tjenester om innkjøp og formidling av kraft til Ål Kraftverk KFs kunder. Ål Kraftverk KF er et heleid kommunalt foretak som er eid av Ål kommune. Foretaket ble opprettet i 1914 og forvalter de kommunale kraftrettighetene for Ål kommune og drifter Ylifossen kraftverk. De kommunale kraftrettighetene består av ca. 101 GWh konsesjonskraft, 80 GWh Erstatningskraft og andelskraft fra Usta og Nest Kraftverk på 45-65 GWh. Kraftverket har også produksjon fra Ylifossen kraftverk på ca. 12 GWh og andel i Lya kravferk på 30 prosent som utgjør ca. 5. GWh. Kommunen får finansielt oppgjør per kvartal av inntekter og kostander fra Lya fra Hafslund Eco. Til sammen utgjør dette rettigheter og produksjon for kommunen på ca. 250 GWh. Foretaket har konsesjon for salg innen Ål kommune sine grenser og kjøper tjenester for om lag 3500 kunder. Foretakets kunder hadde behov for ca. 81,3 GWh i 2025. 1.2 Omfanget av oppdraget Denne anskaffelsen innebærer en avtale om en tjeneste i form av innkjøp og videreformidling av kraft til Ål kraftverk KFs sluttbrukerkunder. Foretaket tilbyr en rekke ulike produkter til næringskunder, innbyggere, fritidsboliger og til kommunalt forbruk. Tjenesten leverandøren skal utføre for Ål Kraftverk KF er å kjøpe inn kraft for å dekke behovet til Ål kraftverk KFs sluttbrukerkunder for de ulike produktene kraftverket tilbyr. Kommunen vil dekke avviket mellom tilbyderens utgifter til kjøp av kraft i spotmarkedet på NordPool og inntektene fra detaljsalg til kunder av Ål Kraftverk KF. Kommunen betaler – for sitt forbruk – i dag en fastpris for kraft på 15 øre/KWh, men dette er foreslått endret til 20 øre/KWh for å gjenspeile selvkosten for kraften. For de øvrige kunder tilbys følgende produkter: Spotpris Fleksikraft på 1. 2. eller 3 år . - Inntil 80 % av fjorårets forbruk til fastpris og forbruket over dette tilbys til spotpris uten påslag. Fastprisen varierer for hvor mange år kunden ønsker å binde seg. Fleksikraft tilbys alle kunder av Ål Kraftverk KF. 3. Ål Kraftverk – Vinter - Inntil 80 % av forventa årsforbruk med fast profil gjennom året. Avtalen gjelder fra 1. november til 30. april. For neste periode er prisen på 161,2 øre/KWh. For forbruket utover fastprisen gjelder spotpris uten påslag. 4. Ål Kraftverk KF har også en kundegruppe som mottar gratis kraft. Dette som en del av konsesjonsvilkår for Holsutbyggingen og kalles Votnakraft. Dette forbruket er på ca. 4,4 GWh og det er tale om ca. 250 anlegg. Se nærmere om kravene til leveransen som skal tilbys Ål Kraftverk KFs kunder under punkt 2. Kontraktene reguleres av kontraktsvilkårene som er vedlagt konkurransegrunnlaget og spesifikasjonene som kommer frem i konkurransegrunnlaget. 1.3 Anbudskonkurransen vektlegger ikke klima- og miljøhensyn Etter anskaffelsesloven § 5b fremgår det i annet ledd at en «oppdragsgiver skal vekte klima- og miljøhensyn med minimum tretti prosent». Det vil i denne anbudskonkurransen likevel ikke legges vekt på klima- og miljøhensyn da anskaffelsen har et «uvesentlig klimaavtrykk», jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5b tredje ledd. Tjenesten Ål Kraftverk KF anskaffer omhandler håndteringen av kjøp av kraft og videreformidling av Ål Kraftverks sluttbrukerkunder. Det er tale om menneskelige ressurser i form av arbeidsinnsats som kjøpes, der klimaavtrykket og miljøbelastningen ligger utenfor hva som kan knyttes til anskaffelsens art jf. Direktoratet for forvaltning og økonomistyring (DFØ) sin veileder om klima og miljøhensyn i offentlige anskaffelser. Kommunen er dermed unntatt forpliktelsene om å evaluere på klima og miljø. NB! Se vedlagte konkurransegrunnlag

title: Spain – Hotel accommodation services – concesión del servicio de explotación del Hotel Oromana (C-2026/032)
description: El objeto del presente contrato es la concesión del servicio de explotación del Hotel Oromana, de titularidad municipal, situado en el municipio de Alcalá de Guadaíra, que comprende la gestión integral del establecimiento, así como la ejecución de las actuaciones necesarias de rehabilitación, reforma, posible ampliación y adecuación del inmueble para su correcto funcionamiento y mejora de categoría, todo ello conforme a lo establecido en el correspondiente pliego de prescripciones técnicas. La presente contratación tiene como finalidad la transformación integral del establecimiento hotelero, con el objetivo de su adecuación a los estándares actuales del sector y su posicionamiento como hotel de cuatro estrellas, mediante la ejecución de las actuaciones constructivas necesarias y la implantación de un modelo de gestión profesionalizado, eficiente y orientado a la calidad. No se pretende con esta licitación una mera explotación del establecimiento en su estado actual, sino la definición y desarrollo de un proyecto global y coherente que integre la intervención sobre el inmueble con un modelo de gestión hotelera alineado con el valor patrimonial, paisajístico y turístico del entorno en el que se inserta, contribuyendo a reforzar la identidad y singularidad del destino. En este sentido, la concesión deberá orientarse a la creación de una oferta hotelera de calidad, capaz de atraer tanto a visitantes como a usuarios locales, generando actividad económica, empleo y sinergias con otros sectores vinculados al turismo, la cultura y la hostelería, y actuando como elemento dinamizador del municipio y su entorno. Asimismo, el contrato comprende tanto la ejecución de las obras definidas como obligatorias, como, en su caso, la incorporación de mejoras propuestas por los licitadores, así como la gestión integral del establecimiento, incluyendo todos los servicios necesarios para su correcto funcionamiento. El detalle y alcance de todas estas prestaciones se desarrollan en el pliego de prescripciones técnicas que rige la presente contratación.

title: Germany – Load-bearing structure design services – Ingenieurleistungen nach Teil 4 Abschnitt 1 HOAI (Tragwerksplanung)
description: Technische Hochschule Mannheim, 68163 Mannheim, Paul-Wittsack-Str. 6, Gebäude G (alt), Gesamtsanierung Laborgebäude Ingenieurleistungen der Tragwerksplanung nach Teil 4 Abschnitt 1 HOAI, Grundleistungen der Leistungsphasen 1 bis 6 sowie Besondere Leistungen der Leistungsphasen 1, 3, 4 und 8. Das Land Baden-Württemberg, vertreten durch Vermögen und Bau Baden-Württemberg, beabsichtigt die Generalsanierung des Gebäudes G (Altbau) der Technischen Hochschule Mannheim. Das Gebäude G (Altbau) der Technischen Hochschule Mannheim wurde in den Jahren 1970 bis 1972 errichtet und dient als Labor- und Hörsaalgebäude. Aufgrund der langen Nutzungszeit von über 50 Jahren entspricht das Gebäude in baulicher, brandschutztechnischer und haustechnischer Hinsicht nicht mehr dem heutigen Stand der Technik, daher soll es generalsaniert werden. Es handelt sich um einen zweigeschossigen Stahlbetonskelettbau mit Untergeschoss und einer Nutzfläche von 1.473 m². Es beinhaltet bisher auf beiden Geschossen Laborbereiche (Kategorie S1) mit einer großen Anzahl von Digestorien und einen sich über das UG und EG erstreckenden innenliegenden Hörsaal mit ansteigendem Gestühl, im Bestand derzeit ohne natürliche Belichtung. Das Gebäude hat eine Grundfläche von 26,10m x 39,90m. Die Flächen der Generalsanierung belaufen sich auf 1.473 m² NUF R, die Gesamtfläche mit Verkehrs- und Technikflächen beläuft sich auf 2.929 m² NRF. Die Nutzung als Labor- und Hörsaalgebäude bleibt auch für die Zukunft erhalten. Die Generalsanierung beinhaltet den Rückbau des Gebäudes bis auf die statische Konstruktion. Die bisherige Stahlbetonfertigteilfassade wird demontiert - hier ist in gestalterischer und energetischer Hinsicht eine komplett neue Fassade gewünscht. Moderne Lernformen sind bei der Neukonzeption zu berücksichtigen und zu ermöglichen, etwa Lernflächen in den Flurzonen oder Projektgruppen-Arbeitsräume. Bisher fehlende Funktionsräume wie z. B. Umkleiden für die Labore oder barrierefreie WC-Anlagen sind zu ergänzen. Die geschätzten Bauwerkskosten sind ca. 19,3 Mio. €, für die KG 300 wird von 8,1 Mio. € und für die KG 400 von 11,2 Mio. € ausgegangen. Die bauzeitliche, geprüfte Statik von 1969 inkl. Nachträgen liegt vor, eine repräsentative Bestandsaufnahme und Bewertung tragender Bauteile ist dennoch notwendig. Der Baubeginn ist für Ende 2030 geplant, die Baufertigstellung für Ende 2033.

Het betreft één van de afzonderlijke aanbestedingstrajecten die de Gemeente in het kader van de Integrale Ontwerpopgave voor de nieuwbouw van theater Nieuwe Meervaart en de herontwikkeling van de zuidwestoever van de Sloterplas (de Integrale Ontwerpopgave) separaat zal uitvoeren. De Bouwkostenmanager werkt samen met het multidisciplinaire architectenteam dat verantwoordelijk is voor de Integrale Ontwerpopgave en met de overige disciplines die bij deze opgave zijn betrokken. Deze disciplines vormen gezamenlijk het Ontwerpteam. De Bouwkostenmanager maakt als afzonderlijke discipline deel uit van het Ontwerpteam en draagt vanuit zijn specifieke deskundigheid bij dat de Integrale Ontwerpopgave binnen het beschikbare budget kan worden gerealiseerd.

title: Netherlands – Software programming and consultancy services – Bedrijfsvoeringseenheid Bommelerwaard - EA BOR-beheersysteem
description: De opdracht omvat de levering, implementatie, exploitatie en ondersteuning van een Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) BOR-beheersysteem (disciplines Groen en Wegen) voor de gemeenten Maasdriel en Zaltbommel. De opdracht omvat: • het beschikbaar stellen van de benodigde SaaS-licenties en hosting gedurende de contractperiode; • de migratie van gegevens vanuit de huidige beheersystemen; • de implementatie, configuratie, inrichting, beproeving en gebruiksklare oplevering van het systeem conform het Programma van Eisen; • de realisatie en ingebruikname van de in het Programma van Eisen voorgeschreven koppelingen; • het verzorgen van opleidingen voor eindgebruikers, functioneel beheerders en applicatiebeheerders; • het leveren van helpdesk- en supportdiensten tijdens kantooruren (08.00–17.00 uur), met een reactietijd bij kritieke storingen van maximaal één uur; • het uitvoeren van technisch beheer, systeembeheer, preventief en correctief onderhoud, updates en upgrades gedurende de contractperiode. De totale geraamde opdrachtwaarde voor beide gemeenten gezamenlijk bedraagt € 647.500 exclusief btw over de gehele looptijd, inclusief de verlengingsopties, de mogelijke afname van optionele modules en de mogelijke overbruggingsverlenging. Deze raming is gebaseerd op het huidige prijspeil. De Overeenkomst bevat een jaarlijkse indexeringsregeling. Aan de raming kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. De daadwerkelijke opdrachtwaarde is afhankelijk van de daadwerkelijke looptijd van de Overeenkomst, de afname van optionele modules en de toepassing van de indexeringsregeling. Opdrachtgever is niet verplicht de verlengingsopties te benutten of optionele modules af te nemen.
